result_summary.title: Production Analytics Dashboard returning 500 errors for APAC users
result_summary.description: We are experiencing high-severity issues with our Analytics Dashboard in the production environment (APAC region). Starting around 09:00 UTC, users began receiving HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses when attempting to load the main dashboard view. This is affecting approximately 790 active users who are currently unable to access their reporting data. The error occurs consistently on page load. Please investigate the server logs for the APAC cluster as this is blocking business operations.
